saw_lines: Fashion buyers compare cut, fit and price, then return to the same coat days later before they buy.
So the sale is won in the opener, when a buyer decides whether the sale is worth a second look.
Your 6 of 10 copy ads open on one line, so the account tells one story; test two or three new openers from your own range, such as Mäntel Highlights and Drykorn.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 30 Oct 2026
points: 6 of your 10 copy ads open on one line, so the account tells one story. Test two or three new openers from your own range, such as the Mäntel Highlights coat edit and the Drykorn pieces, one per ad.
Same copy runs in six ads
One exact copy runs in 6 of 10 ads, so the same words reach your buyers again and again. Keep the body text but change the opening line and the creative in each of the six.

None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so a first time buyer has nothing concrete to trust. Collect one figure, such as your review count or orders shipped, and lead three ads with it, placed on the creative itself.
20 of your 30 ads are feed ads with no story, so the feed gives no reason to stop. Add three story ads showing a person in one piece from Max Mara Studio, Cinque or Comma, each linked to its range.
